method: Whole HelpersInterface.cpp782lines and header manually read; pinned Git bytes matched. No Windows helper execution.
findings: NormalizeScanPaths splits pipe list, trims spaces/empty entries, expands native paths with _wfullpath when successful, preserves MTP spelling, normalizes extended/native path key and lowercases. Adds trailing separator to key before ancestor-prefix checks, preventing similar-name sibling prefix collapse.

Normalization removes previously admitted descendants when later ancestor arrives and skips newly covered descendants. It does not resolve physical symlink/junction/file identity, and lowercased keys may collapse case-distinct selected roots; case-sensitive Windows directory behavior remains untested.

GlobToRegex escapes regex metacharacters, collapses repeated stars to nonseparator wildcard and maps question mark to single nonseparator character. Wildcards exclude slash/backslash/colon and optional anchors wrap complete pattern. This is component wildcard matching, not recursive double-star semantics.

SplitString trims literal spaces at both ends of each token; JoinString delimits based on current output nonempty state. These are application serialization conventions, not lossless arbitrary filename-list encoding.

CreateShellItemArray retains PIDLs while aggregating and allOrNothing mode rejects entire selection if any identity fails; default may omit unresolved items. Context-menu helper explicitly requires allOrNothing.

COM scope balances successful initializations and rejects incompatible mode via false; resource decompression uses function-static context pointer and ignores FDICopy result. No concurrent decompression or malformed resource runtime qualification.

Formatting uses locale-cached separators and rounded suffixes; numeric display is not exact identity evidence. FormatDouble multiplies by100 then narrows to int, so arbitrary large/floating exceptional inputs not generically qualified.
Small rectangle storage narrows coordinates to WORD, unlike full signed CRect; negative/large coordinate preservation cannot be inferred. Actual consumers still require review.
limits: No Windows full-path/case-sensitive filesystem, shell, localization, resources or render runtime executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred.
